slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total amount of money available at the end of the three-year horizon?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed the meaning of the objective ('earnings'), confirming it as final wealth at end of year 3 rather than net profit, which directly targets the earnings/final-wealth-vs-profit ambiguity.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1, P2) was resolved at turn 1, yet the agent then repeated the identical holding-period question from turn 4 through turn 30 without ever producing a final model or READY_TO_MODEL, i.e. repeated low-value questioning after all relevant slots were addressed.

summary: The agent quickly and correctly clarified the lone hidden slot (objective/earnings definition), but then degenerated into a runaway loop, asking the same already-answered holding-period question 27 times and never reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
